name: SimplyCash Preferred Card from American Express

localized_names.en: SimplyCash Preferred Card from American Express

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: Charged monthly at $9.99 for non-Quebec residents ($119.88 a year); Quebec residents pay $119 a year.

apr.notes: Preferred annual interest rate 21.99% on purchases and funds advances; higher rates apply after missed payments.

credit_required.notes: Canadian resident with a Canadian credit file.

categories.label: Grocery in Canada (up to $1,200 cash back annually)

rewards.redemption_notes: Cash back is credited to the account.

signup_bonus.description: Bonus 10% cash back on up to $2,000 in purchases in the first 3 months (up to $200), plus a $50 statement credit for a purchase in month 13.

notes: American Express Canada cards have no network package tier, so network_tier is none.
